chapter.title: Power, Grounding & the Hum
chapter.sub: Two paths to ground make an antenna.

items.alt: A mixer and a laptop connected by an audio cable. Each is plugged into a different outlet; a dashed red loop runs between their grounds. A low HMMMMM fills the room.
narration: 60-cycle hum. The oldest ghost in the rack.

items.alt: The same diagram, labeled: two paths to ground make a loop. Ray explains from the side.

bubbles.text: Two paths to ground is a loop. A loop becomes an antenna. An antenna becomes a hum.

items.alt: Fixed: the mixer and the laptop now share one power strip — one ground, one system — with every safety earth left connected.

bubbles.text: One ground. One system. Less noise.

items.text: FIELD NOTE —  Startup and shutdown order matters too — faders down first, amplifiers on last and off first. Protect the speakers, protect the moment.
